@johnsonjiang-xiao Nope, I just made my clone of code and updated components/tuya/util.py code to:
```
"""Utility methods for the Tuya integration."""
from __future__ import annotations


def remap_value(
    value: float | int,
    from_min: float | int = 0,
    from_max: float | int = 255,
    to_min: float | int = 0,
    to_max: float | int = 255,
    reverse: bool = False,
) -> float:
    """Remap a value from its current range, to a new range."""
    value = float(value)
    if reverse:
        value = from_max - value + from_min
    return ((value - from_min) / (from_max - from_min)) * (to_max - to_min) + to_min
```

this fixed the issue temporarily. Some fixes in the source code itself are necessary. So that other users who are facing this problem can also use the component. I was waiting for the maintainers to reply to this.
